reason: Conversation 2 correctly linked Er03 to the boil-over onto the controls, advised isolating and drying, recommended no part, and once the customer confirmed it worked after drying, sensibly cleared them to use it with a spill-wiping tip. Conversation 1 misdiagnosed overheat protection despite the obvious boil-over clue, then escalated to a 'stop using this appliance / call an electrician' response that was disproportionate for a hard-wired hob with a standard liquid-on-controls cut-off and never got to the correct wipe-and-reset step. Conversation 2 did overstate the fault ('short-circuit protection', 'permanent damage to the control PCB', 24-hour drying) and its final reply was thin, but it reached the right outcome without unnecessary cost or alarm.
